>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/channels/{channelId}/templates"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



This endpoint returns the Viber message templates registered for the channel, along with their current approval status with Viber.

Retrieving Viber templates requires an admin role on the account.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>
